description: Jazzer-driven byte[] fuzz against eu.exeris.kernel.core.http.http2.Http2FrameParser.parseHeader. Each fuzz iteration copies the mutated byte[] into a confined Arena MemorySegment and decodes the 9-byte RFC 7540 frame header. Whitelisted throwables (IndexOutOfBoundsException, IllegalArgumentException, BufferUnderflowException) are recorded but do NOT count as findings. Any other Throwable is a finding.
comparison_axis_note: HTTP/2 frame header is exactly 9 bytes (length:24, type:8, flags:8, R+streamId:32). Fuzz iterations with len<9 short-circuit and are not counted toward iterations_total.
